# macOS detach warnings can corrupt the test executable path

The AI diagnosis for Try revision 5db2617d72d0ff090d74024bf463f736d2c492d0 reports that job 599091070 failed before Thunderbird started: a disk-image detach warning printed by mozinstall entered the installer output that mozharness used as binary_path. The harness then rejected the path and reported no checks run. For similar macOS harness failures, inspect installer output and the --appname path before attributing the failure to application code. The report cites raw-log sections and source locations, but those artifacts are not independently confirmed by the supplied evidence. This diagnosis does not establish a failure in calendar Save behavior or any passing runtime tests.

Scope: macOS test installation infrastructure.
